sources.title: Setogawa River / Shirakabe Dozo
sources.inspection: Text read; official canal photos viewed in browser
sources.notes: Canal beside white plaster/storehouse fronts and stone edges; water connected to daily use. Narrow corridor and small frontage relationship visible.

sources.title: Hida Furukawa walking itinerary
sources.notes: Walking itinerary links ordinary production/craft businesses and canal neighborhood. Useful street-life context, not measured dimensions.

sources.title: Hachimanbori
sources.notes: Artificial waterway linked trade and town; white-walled storehouses and wooden merchant residences. Maintenance/restoration is a community activity.

sources.title: Yanagawa waterway explanation
sources.notes: Canal network relates drainage, agricultural water and daily water use. Water is working neighborhood infrastructure, not only scenery.

sources.title: Yanagawa official destination
sources.inspection: Text and official main photograph viewed
sources.notes: Waterway beside mixed roof/wall forms, maintained shrubs, willow-like foliage and utility lines. Tourist boat shown; its role is not adopted for Home.

sources.title: Hita/Mamedamachi everyday commercial context
sources.notes: Brewery grounds beside Hanatsuki river and restored merchant shops connect waterways with local work/craft.

sources.title: River landscape formation and conservation summary
sources.inspection: Nine-page summary text read; p3, p8–9 relevant
sources.notes: Guideline dated October 2006. Connects microtopography, flow, vegetation, regional history and human use; distinguishes structural landscape design from design of individual places.

sources.title: Tiny Glade
sources.inspection: Official landing image visually inspected; official description read
sources.notes: Developer describes a small relaxing diorama builder. Visible forms use softened masonry/timber, grouped foliage and compact layered volumes. Landing image is promotional, not camera/performance evidence.

sources.title: A Short Hike
sources.inspection: Official gameplay screenshot grid and description viewed
sources.notes: Marked trails and optional backcountry exploration documented. Screens show clear warm paths against quieter vegetation/rock and distinguishable elevation masses.

sources.title: A Short Hike postmortem
sources.inspection: Abstract read only; full talk not watched
sources.notes: Creator discusses visual style, level design and production under a limited compact open-world scope. No detailed technique inferred from an unwatched talk.

sources.title: Townscaper
sources.inspection: Official store description and media viewed
sources.notes: Block-built waterfront toy documented; visual grammar uses coherent roof/façade rhythm, water negative space and clear connected platforms. Web demo loading view did not provide useful visual evidence.

sources.title: Dordogne
sources.inspection: Publisher page and official developer/publisher store copy read; watercolor wording verified in About This Game, not user reviews
sources.notes: Hand-painted watercolor presentation is documented. Used for material/detail hierarchy only, not as evidence of an orthographic 3D runtime or a mobile budget.

third_party_boundary: Read/view only. No screenshots/raw assets copied to repository or sent as generative inputs. Production grammar/principles only.
